$comment: Runtime configuration for the map view. Every upstream service, URL, magic number and marker style the page depends on lives here so that retargeting a tile server, widening the event filter or tuning the fallback radius needs no code change.

map.$comment: Initial camera. [36.7783, -119.4179] at zoom 6 frames the state of California, which is the whole area the project covers.
map.$comment_defaultFire: On entering the map view the page immediately draws one simulated fire so the screen is never empty. These are downtown Los Angeles coordinates.

weather.$comment: Open-Meteo forecast API. Keyless. 'current' drives the overlay and the growth model; 'hourly' is requested but only logged today.
weather.$comment_readout: Order and labelling of the overlay readout. 'key' indexes into the API's `current` object; omitting an entry removes that row from the overlay.
weather.$comment_legacyReadout: Fallback shape for the older `current_weather` response, kept because the original page handled both.

eonet.$comment: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker, v3. Only open wildfire events are requested.
eonet.$comment_minEventYear: Events older than this are skipped. This was hard-coded as 2025 in the original page; it is config now, but the value is left exactly as it shipped.
eonet.$comment_radius: EONET reports wildfire magnitude in acres. Treating the burn as a circle, radius = sqrt(area / pi); 4046.8564224 is the exact square metres in an international acre.

geocoding.$comment: OpenStreetMap Nominatim reverse geocoder, used to turn an event's coordinates into a place name when its marker is clicked.
geocoding.$comment_placeKeys: Tried in order against the Nominatim `address` object; the first present value wins. Ordered most to least specific.
